queries: WITH t AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), a AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM t) SELECT AVG(t.total) AS avg_total, SUM(t.n) AS total_expenses, AVG(t.total - a.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM t, a WHERE t.total > a.avg_total

assumptions.assumption: 'Average spend per budget line' is the average of per-budget-line expense totals, computed over budget lines that have at least one expense (budget lines with no expenses are excluded from the average).
Spend is computed by summing expense.cost, not by using budget.spent; expenses with NULL link_to_budget are ignored; approval status is not filtered.
'How many expenses altogether' is the count of expense rows across the above-average budget lines.

alternatives.interpretation: Average spend per budget line is taken over all budget lines, with budget lines that have no expenses counting as 0 total.

assumptions.assumption: The average spend per budget line is the average of per-budget expense totals, taken over budget lines that have at least one expense. Budget lines with no expenses are not counted.
Spend is computed from the expense table's cost column, not from budget.spent. Expenses are counted regardless of their approved status.
The 'average total' is the mean of the expense totals for the above-average budget lines. The 'excess' is each line's total minus the overall average, averaged across those lines.

alternatives.interpretation: The average spend per budget line covers every row in the budget table, so budget lines with no expenses count as 0 spend.
